experiment: RUT-1 stage 4R: the reciprocal, energy-accounted benchmark

model.field: tau_form h_tt + gamma h_t + h/tau_keep = alpha W * rho
model.energy: H = sum m[v^2/2 - GM/r - C(X)] + tau_form/(2 alpha) int h_t^2 + 1/(2 alpha tau_keep) int h^2

same_response.note: the grid model interpolates a cubic spline of carried value and gradient arrays; the spectral model evaluates its truncated Fourier series exactly, so their agreement bounds the grid representation error of the field every formation run uses

energy_balance.note: the dissipated power has a derived rate and a named destination -- the field damping -- but the physical reservoir that receives it is not identified

trajectories.note: an independent spatial representation of the same equation reproduces the trajectories the grid formation runs compute

limits: writing proportional to mass and a symmetric Gaussian kernel; no identified physical reservoir; no spatial causality; no momentum accounting for the reservoir and the fixed centre
